title: Smiling Girl in Pinafore at Apple Lodge Cabin, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length portrait of a smiling young girl standing outside a rustic summer cabin labeled 'APPLE LODGE · 1'. She wears a short-sleeved dress with a decorative bib collar and horizontal striped trim, paired with dark ankle socks and strapped shoes. Surrounding her are blooming garden bushes against the dark timber siding of the cabin porch. The image reflects mid-1930s American summer camp and vacation culture, where families and youth retreated into nature during the Great Depression.
